description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. One short silver sword with dark blue handle pointing up-right, encircled on its left by one LARGE orange curved U-turn arrow with a clearly visible triangular arrowhead pointing back toward the sword. The orange counterattack arrow must occupy half the image. Two distinct simple shapes. No shield, no text.
